meta.name: multistep-v1
meta.note: Multi-step tasks: each needs a set of tools called (then a stop). The tool inventory per task includes distractors. Scored on the real loop failure modes single-turn routing can't see: premature-stop (stopped before done), over-run (extra/looping calls or never stops), and missteps (wrong tool). `required` is the correct tool set; order is recorded but scored leniently as a set for now.
